summary: NCL Corporation Ltd. (NCLC), a subsidiary of Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd., filed an 8-K to elect irrevocable cash settlement for all exchanges of its 1.125% and 2.50% Exchangeable Senior Notes due 2027. Effective May 29, 2026, any future exchanges will be settled in cash rather than shares, reducing diluted share count guidance by ~2M shares for Q2 2026 and ~4M for full-year 2026. This is an issuer election under existing indentures, not a new capital return or tender. Watch for EPS accretion and potential impact on note pricing; no risk-arb angle.
